title: AIOps Modernization for Vodafone India
request_text:
Vodafone India operates a heterogeneous network spanning Nokia core infrastructure, Huawei radio access, and Ericsson transport layers, leading to fragmented observability and a current MTTR of 90 minutes.

Requirements:
- Current MTTR: 90 minutes; Target MTTR: 25 minutes
- Reduce daily alert volume by 60% through event correlation and noise suppression
- Achieve 99.95% network availability with proactive incident detection
- Integration with existing Nokia, Huawei, and Ericsson OSS systems
- SLA: 99.99% uptime guarantee, critical incident response within 15 minutes
- Implementation timeline: 6 months
- Estimated annual savings: $3M; ROI period: 14 months

Evaluation Criteria: Business impact and ROI clarity; technical fit for telecom operations; delivery feasibility; commercial flexibility; differentiation against incumbent vendors.
